## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Singleton 90% conformal set [F1] with 0% invasive risk, though top concept explanations are unvalidated.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 97%, InSitu 2%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong benign call; minimal alternatives |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% alpha (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 76th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Clean input; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match each other |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%), 1 InSitu, 1 Normal [F5] | Moderate match; close InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.16 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.40 contribution); weak concept, 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical score (+0.38 contribution); 8/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical confinement (+0.31 contribution); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.14 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (diff +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 spans 0); top drivers (Normal lobules, Frequent mitotic figures) are Unreliable (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ disease is present, resembling contrast case BACH_0043 (InSitu, 88% similarity), which differs in mitoses and stroma.
- Frozen-section artifacts mask atypia; HoVer-Net flagged insufficient tumor nuclei (only 5 neoplastic cells across regions 4, 7, 11).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11, 4**: Highest heatmap risk, 5 neoplastic nuclei, and 70%–94% margin segments (called clear [F7]).
2. **Regions 7, 8, 11**: Confirm benign two-layered lobules and fibrous stroma/fat directly rather than trusting concept scores.
3. **Regions 0, 3, 6**: Exclude ductal atypia (region 6), stromal infiltration (region 3), or mitotic activity (region 0).
